answer: Attestation weight is minted only for identities whose funding provenance and submit timing stay uncorrelated in peer graph. Each epoch an agent must forge a bond commitment over the beacon nonce before its answer is visible; a clustering pass correlates funding source, timing and phrasing. A tight cluster is a willow of clones: the whole herd's bonds burn together on slash. A sybil farm must buy independently funded, uniquely timed keys and keep each alive several closed epochs before one vote counts - real capital and latency per fake agent. Quartz-firm history buys weight, not fresh keys.
